24308.d: The Smoke Dungeon is a series of winding tunnels located underneath the Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The dungeon can be reached from the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon by travelling through the dark stairs. Alternately, the dungeon can be reached by climbing down a smokey well west of Pollnivneach.

The dark stairs are located in the south-east corner of the Smoke Dungeon side and directly west of the entrance from the well in the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon side. The dark stairs turn into a dark hole once you go down them. In order to use the dark hole to leave, it must first be used from the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon side. The player will refuse to use the dark hole from the Smoke Dungeon side first as they do not know where it leads.

On the west side of the Smoke Dungeon is a rope that leads to a smokey well in the desert. Access to the Smoke Dungeon via the well entrance can be unlocked in the quest, Desert Treasure. The well can also be reached by heading directly east from the mystical mirrors, which surround the Bandit Camp lodestone.
